== Description ([[Astrography]] & [[Planetology]]) == 
* A low-population, non-industrial {{Imperial}} world located in the [[Masionia Subsector]] of the [[Lishun Sector]]. 
* This [[world]] is part of the [[Dynam Cluster]].

=== Historical Data ===
The early years of the [[Third Imperium]] saw the belt as an active mining community. 

==== World Timeline ====
* By [[520]] the belter activity had ceased due to lack of finds. 
* In [[690]] the [[Imperial Navy]] first established a naval depot in the Dynam system, around the moon Cryomet. 
* [[800s]] Project LONGBOW was initiated.  LONGBOW is an acronym for “Long Baseline Observation Window,” the name for a system created for observation of the galactic core and the [[Zhodani]] axis of exploration toward the core.  The Longbow collector plane was located in the {{WorldS|Depot (Li 1219)|Lishun|1219}} system as part of a sprawling [[Imperial Navy]] facility there, aiding in its concealment.
* By [[940]] depot operations began to wind down. 
* In [[990]], following the [[Third Frontier War]], the Navy decided to use the system as a center for mothballing reserve ships. The initial set of 150 obsolete ships from the [[Spinward Marches Sector]] were put into orbit around Candescene. 
* In [[1002]], after the [[Solomani Rim War]] another 300 ships were added to the graveyard. 
* By [[1010]], the original depot on Cryomet was completely shutdown. 
** Over the years more ships have been added to the depot. 
* By [[1100]] there were more than a thousand mothballed ships.
